prompt: Read one SENTENCE containing width and height separated by one space. Use strings.SPLIT and strings.TO_NUMBER to obtain the two NUMBER values. Print the rectangle area on the first line and perimeter on the second line. Print no labels.
Read one NUMBER integer. Print EVEN when it is divisible by 2; otherwise print ODD.
Read a nonnegative NUMBER integer n. Using a LOOP, print the sum of the squares from 1 through n. Print only the result.
Define and use a FUNCTION that returns the cube of a NUMBER. Read one NUMBER and print its cube. Print only the result.

Read one SENTENCE containing three numbers separated by spaces. Convert them with strings.SPLIT and strings.TO_NUMBER, place them in a NUMBER array, and print the smallest value. Use array indexing and a LOOP.
Read one SENTENCE and print it reversed using the strings library. Print only the reversed text.
Read one SENTENCE and print exactly that sentence on one line, with no added label.
Read a nonnegative NUMBER integer n and compute n factorial using iteration. Print only the result.
Read one SENTENCE containing x and y separated by one space. Convert both with strings.SPLIT and strings.TO_NUMBER, then print x*x + 3*y. Print only the result.
Read a NUMBER Celsius temperature and print its Fahrenheit value using c*9/5+32. Print only the result.

Read one SENTENCE containing price, quantity, and discountPercent separated by spaces. Convert them with strings.SPLIT and strings.TO_NUMBER, then print price*quantity*(1-discountPercent/100). Print only the result.
Read one SENTENCE containing three numbers separated by spaces. Convert them with strings.SPLIT and strings.TO_NUMBER and print the greatest value. Print only the result.
Read one NUMBER. Print NEGATIVE if it is below zero, ZERO if it equals zero, and POSITIVE otherwise.

Read one SENTENCE containing three positive side lengths separated by spaces. Convert them with strings.SPLIT and strings.TO_NUMBER. If they cannot form a triangle print INVALID. Otherwise print EQUILATERAL, ISOSCELES, or SCALENE. Print exactly one label.
Read a nonnegative NUMBER integer n. Using a LOOP, print the sum of all even integers from 1 through n. Print only the result.

Read one SENTENCE containing a NUMBER base and nonnegative integer exponent separated by one space. Convert them with strings.SPLIT and strings.TO_NUMBER. Using a LOOP, compute base raised to exponent and print the result.
Read a nonnegative NUMBER integer n. Using a LOOP, print i*i on its own line for every integer i from 1 through n. For n=0 print nothing.

Define and use a FUNCTION that returns the absolute difference of two NUMBER values. Read one SENTENCE containing the two numbers separated by a space, convert them with strings.SPLIT and strings.TO_NUMBER, and print the function result.

Define a FUNCTION square(x) and a second FUNCTION sumOfSquares(a,b) that calls square for both arguments. Read one SENTENCE containing two numbers separated by a space, convert them with strings.SPLIT and strings.TO_NUMBER, and print sumOfSquares(a,b).

Define and use a FUNCTION totalWithTax(amount, ratePercent) that returns amount*(1+ratePercent/100). Read one SENTENCE containing amount and ratePercent separated by a space, convert them with strings.SPLIT and strings.TO_NUMBER, and print the result.

Read one SENTENCE containing four numbers separated by spaces. Convert them with strings.SPLIT and strings.TO_NUMBER, create a NUMBER array, use a LOOP and array indexing to sum its elements, and print the sum.

Read one SENTENCE containing three numbers separated by spaces. Convert them with strings.SPLIT and strings.TO_NUMBER into an array. Print the values in reverse order, one per line, using array indexing and a LOOP.

Read one SENTENCE containing five data numbers and then one threshold, all separated by spaces. Convert them with strings.SPLIT and strings.TO_NUMBER. Put the five data values in an array, then use a LOOP to count how many are strictly greater than the threshold. Print the count.
Read one SENTENCE. Using the strings library, print its length on the first line and its uppercase form on the second line.
Read a lowercase SENTENCE with no spaces. Use a LOOP and the strings library to print PALINDROME if it reads the same backward, otherwise print NOT PALINDROME.
Read one SENTENCE in the form text|fragment, with no pipe inside either value. Split at the pipe using the strings library and print how many non-overlapping occurrences of fragment appear in text.
Read one SENTENCE in the form name|age. Split at the pipe, convert age with strings.TO_NUMBER, and print one line in the exact form name:age with no spaces around the colon.
Read one SENTENCE in the form first|second. Split at the pipe, then print second on the first output line and first on the second output line, with no labels.

Read one SENTENCE in the form character|count, where character is one letter and count is 0 through 5. Split at the pipe, obtain the LETTER with strings.CHARAT and convert count with strings.TO_NUMBER. Print the letter count times on one line with no separators. Use a LOOP.

Read one SENTENCE containing two positive integers separated by a space. Convert them with strings.SPLIT and strings.TO_NUMBER, use a LOOP to test candidate divisors, and print their greatest common divisor.
Read a nonnegative NUMBER integer n. Print PRIME if n is prime and NOT PRIME otherwise. Test divisors with a LOOP.
Read a nonnegative NUMBER integer n. Using a LOOP and the math library, print the sum of its decimal digits. For n=0 print 0.
Read one SENTENCE containing three numbers separated by spaces. Convert them and print 0.2 times the first plus 0.3 times the second plus 0.5 times the third.
Read one SENTENCE containing three distinct numbers separated by spaces. Convert them and print the middle value.
Read a nonnegative NUMBER integer n and use a LOOP to print the sum of odd integers from 1 through n.
Define and use a FUNCTION that uses a LOOP to return the sum from 1 through a nonnegative integer n. Read n and print the result.
Read one SENTENCE containing four numbers separated by spaces. Convert them into an array and print them rotated left by one position, one per line. Use a LOOP.
Read a lowercase SENTENCE and use a LOOP plus the strings library to count and print its vowels.
Read one SENTENCE in the form a|b|c. Split at pipes and print c, then a, then b on separate lines.
Read one SENTENCE containing two positive integers separated by a space. Convert them and print their least common multiple using iteration.
